metadata.description: Erlangen Cricket Club members' app: match and practice availability, attendance and squad selection.

reason.title: Not going?
reason.description: Tell your captain why. Only you, your captain and the Board see it.
reason.label: Reason
reason.motion: ECC league matches come first: not going to play tennis- or tape-ball cricket is not allowed (motion 2026/03).

attendance.notActive: The 2-of-4 rule starts once 4 practices have taken place.
